name: Duckdns
description: Duckdns is a free service which will point a DNS (sub domains of duckdns.org) to an IP of your choice. The service is completely free, and doesn't require reactivation or forum posts to maintain its existence.
short_desc: Duckdns is a free service which will point a DNS (sub domains of duckdns.org) to an IP of your choice
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: SUBDOMAINS
form_fields.hint: multiple subdomains allowed, comma separated, no spaces, if your domain is user.duckdns.org you put user, not a sub-subdomain

form_fields.label: UPDATE_IP
form_fields.hint: Set to ipv6 or ipv4 to update only your public IPv4/6 address. Set to both to update IPv6 and IPv4 address. This variable makes use of a third-party service. Omitting this variable uses DuckDNS for detection and only supports IPv4. both and ipv6 modes needs host networking.

form_fields.label: LOG_FILE
form_fields.hint: Set to true to log to file (also need to map /config).
